good_function_equality.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = fn_min_uuidv7(now() - interval '7 days')

bad_nonkey_function_equality.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE payload = fn_min_uuidv7(now() - interval '7 days')

bad_partial_base_index.definition: SELECT * FROM partial_events WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

bad_nonleading_base_index.definition: SELECT * FROM nonleading_events WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

good_or_different_columns.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= 100 OR created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'

bad_or_unindexed_column.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= 100 OR payload >= 'a'

good_unique_constraint_function.definition: SELECT * FROM unique_events WHERE id = fn_min_uuidv7(now() - interval '7 days')

bad_union_table_arm.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= 100 UNION ALL TABLE orders

bad_cte_table_arm.definition: WITH rows AS (TABLE events) SELECT * FROM rows

bad_nested_outer_on.definition: SELECT e.id FROM (events e RIGHT JOIN orders o ON e.id >= 100 AND o.id >= 100)

bad_nested_full_on.definition: SELECT e.id FROM (events e FULL JOIN orders o ON e.id >= 100 AND o.id >= 100)

good_flattened_outer_where.definition: SELECT e.id FROM events e RIGHT JOIN orders o ON e.id = o.id WHERE e.id >= 100 AND o.id >= 100

bad_function_range_nonkey.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE score >= fn_floor(100)

bad_function_between_nonkey.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE score BETWEEN fn_floor(100) AND fn_floor(200)

good_function_between_key.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id BETWEEN fn_floor(100) AND fn_floor(200)

good_bare_owned_range.definition: SELECT e.id FROM events e CROSS JOIN countries c WHERE score >= 1

bad_bare_ambiguous_range.definition: SELECT e.id FROM events e CROSS JOIN countries c WHERE id >= 1

bad_bare_unknown_peer.definition: SELECT e.id FROM events e CROSS JOIN unavailable_table u WHERE score >= 1

bad_or_different_aliases.definition: SELECT e.id FROM events e CROSS JOIN orders o WHERE e.id >= 100 OR o.id >= 100

bad_multiple_statements.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= 100; SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= 200

good_composite_key_function_range.definition: SELECT * FROM composite_events WHERE id >= fn_min_uuidv7(now() - interval '7 days')

good_composite_key_function_equality.definition: SELECT * FROM composite_events WHERE id = fn_floor(100)

good_qualified_function.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id >= public.fn_floor(100)

good_qualified_temporal_range.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE created_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '7 days'

bad_in_list.definition: SELECT * FROM events WHERE id IN (100, 200)

bad_from_function_subquery.definition: SELECT * FROM generate_series(1, (SELECT max(id) FROM events)) AS g(id)

bad_lateral_function_subquery.definition: SELECT * FROM LATERAL generate_series(1, (SELECT max(id) FROM events)) AS g(id)

bad_unnest_subquery.definition: SELECT * FROM UNNEST(ARRAY[(SELECT max(id) FROM events)]) AS g(id)

good_from_function_rewrite.definition: SELECT generate_series(1, (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE id BETWEEN 100 AND 200)) AS id

bad_renamed_table_columns.definition: SELECT * FROM events AS e(payload, created_at, id) WHERE e.id >= '100'

bad_distinct_subquery.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON ((SELECT max(id) FROM events)) * FROM events WHERE id >= 100

bad_named_window_subquery.definition: SELECT *, row_number() OVER w AS pos FROM events WHERE id >= 100 WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY (SELECT max(id) FROM events))

good_named_window.definition: SELECT *, row_number() OVER w AS pos FROM events WHERE id BETWEEN 100 AND 200 WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY created_at)

good_derived_column_alias.definition: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM events WHERE id BETWEEN 100 AND 200) AS bounded(event_id, occurred_at, event_payload)
